items.title: Bitcoin MVRV: market value ÷ realized value (on-chain cost basis)
items.description: Bitcoin's MVRV ratio (market value divided by realized value, the on-chain cost basis of all coins) since 2019, with the BTC price. In the chart's latest weekly reading (Nov 6) MVRV was 1.41 with BTC near $75.8K, far below the 3.9 peak of 2021.
items.reason: Bitcoin fell back below $60,000 this morning, about 52% under its record, and the Fear & Greed index reads 11 (extreme fear). MVRV shows how close the market is getting to its average cost basis, the zone near 1 that marked the 2022 bottom.

items.title: MSTR mNAV
items.description: Strategy's mNAV (MSTR market price divided by net BTC per share) since October 2025. It slid to 0.97 on Nov 19, the lowest reading on the chart, down from about 1.5 in early October 2025.
items.reason: Strategy's Monday 8-K showed it sold 1.93M MSTR shares to buy 457 BTC and spend $211.8M buying back STRC, and this morning Monness cut its MSTR target to $59, the lowest on the Street. With MSTR trading around its bitcoin value, mNAV is the number everyone is arguing about.

items.title: Chip stocks vs the S&P 500 (SOXX ÷ SPY, total return)
items.description: Chip stocks relative to the S&P 500 (SOXX divided by SPY, total return, Jul 2001 = 100) with SOXX's drawdown from its high. In the latest reading (Nov 6) the ratio was 212, down from a 328 peak, and SOXX was 36% below its high.
items.reason: Semis swung wildly: the Philadelphia chip index jumped about 14% on Monday when Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang, then chip stocks gave back 5-7% this morning and Nvidia fell about 7%. This chart puts the whipsaw in its 25-year context.

items.title: What the bond market expects from the Fed: 2-year Treasury yield minus the effective fed funds rate (month-end)
items.description: The 2-year Treasury yield minus the effective fed funds rate, month-end, since 2000. A positive gap means the bond market is pricing rate hikes; it has been positive every month since March 2026, peaked at 1.0 point at end-September and was 0.58 in early November.
items.reason: Markets still expect the Fed to raise rates by a quarter point in December, and October PCE inflation lands tomorrow morning before Thanksgiving. This is the cleanest picture of how much tightening the bond market is pricing.

items.title: Tesla price-to-sales (market cap ÷ trailing 4-quarter revenue), weekly since 2019
items.description: Tesla's price-to-sales ratio (market cap divided by trailing four-quarter revenue), weekly since 2019. It peaked near 30x in 2020 and sat in the low-to-mid teens through autumn 2026 (13.7x on Nov 6).
items.reason: Tesla jumped 11.5% on Monday to $385.46 in the Nvidia-led rebound while it rolled out a major FSD update. After that move, this chart shows how rich the stock is against its own history.
